messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile-friendly 2D game: farming by day and tower defense by night.

## Requirements
- “Build a complete, playable game now”; do not ask clarifying questions.
- Support phone/tablet touch controls and responsive layout.
- User requested screenshots for checks saved as small JPEGs (viewport ≤1280px); inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created a self-contained browser game with hand-drawn canvas visuals, farming/harvesting economy, and automated tower defense.
- Assumed an original cozy-fantasy setting and progression across increasingly difficult nights.

## Work State
### Completed
